_comment: Updates shown on dist/updates/ (tools/build_home.py), newest first. Add one entry in the same pull request as the change it announces. 'text' is interface text: add it to every dictionary in dist/i18n.js and dist/i18n/. 'link' is optional and relative to the site root.

updates.text: New pages: Stats, Sources and Updates, linked from the top page.
Lang Log is now available in 21 languages.
Maps on record pages can be zoomed and panned, with country borders.
Every family, language and dialect has its own page, at an address that follows its classification.
